## Aspatial Data Handling and Wrangling

### Importing Distance Matrix


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ODMatrix <- read_csv("data/aspatial/OD_Matrix.csv", skip = 0)
```
:::


### Cleaning and updating attribute fields


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
eldercare <- eldercare %>%
  select(fid) %>%
  mutate(capacity = 100) %>%
  rename(id = fid)
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hexagons <- hexagons %>%
  select(fid) %>%
  mutate(demand = 100) %>%
  rename(id = fid)
```
:::


### Tidying distance matrix


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ODMatrix_tidied <- ODMatrix %>%
  select(origin_id, destination_id, total_cost) %>%
  rename(from_id = origin_id,
         to_id = destination_id,
         dist = total_cost)
```
:::


### Deriving the distance matrix


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
distmat <- ODMatrix %>%
  select(origin_id, destination_id, total_cost) %>%
  spread(destination_id, total_cost) %>%
  select(c(-c('origin_id')))
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
distmat_km <- as.matrix(distmat/1000)
```
:::


## Modelling Accessibility using the catchment Package

### Computing 2SFCA


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
df_2sfca <- catchment_ratio(
  consumers = hexagons$demand,
  providers = eldercare$capacity,
  cost = distmat_km,
  max_cost = 5) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename("2SFCA" = ".")
```
:::


### Visualising 2SFCA accessibility


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
mapex <- st_bbox(hexagons)
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hex_2SFCA <- bind_cols(hexagons, df_2sfca)

tm_shape(hex_2SFCA,
         bbox = mapex) + 
  tm_polygons(fill = "2SFCA", 
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 10,
                values = "-brewer.blues")) +
tm_shape(eldercare) +
  tm_dots(size = 0.3,
          fill = "red",
          col = "black") +
  tm_title("2SFCA Accessibility measures") +
  tm_layout(frame = TRUE) +
  tm_compass(type = "8star", size = 2) +
  tm_scalebar() +
  tm_grid(alpha = 0.2)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](inclass-week-7_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-14-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::


### Computing E2SFCA


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
step_weights <- list(c(5, .01), c(4, .05), c(3, .1), c(2, .4), c(1, 1))

df_e2sfca <- catchment_ratio(
  consumers = hexagons$demand,
  providers = eldercare$capacity,
  cost = distmat_km,
  weight = step_weights) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename("E2SFCA" = ".")
```
:::


### Mapping E2SFCA


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hex_E2SFCA <- bind_cols(hexagons, df_e2sfca)

tm_shape(hex_E2SFCA,
         bbox = mapex) + 
  tm_polygons(fill = "E2SFCA", 
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 10,
                values = "-brewer.blues")) +
tm_shape(eldercare) +
  tm_dots(size = 0.3,
          fill = "red",
          col = "black") +
  tm_title("E2SFCA Accessibility measures") +
  tm_layout(frame = TRUE) +
  tm_compass(type = "8star", size = 2) +
  tm_scalebar() +
  tm_grid(alpha = 0.2)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](inclass-week-7_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-16-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::


### Computing KD2SFCA (Kernel Density, Gaussian)


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
df_kd2sfca <- catchment_ratio(
  consumers = hexagons$demand,
  providers = eldercare$capacity,
  cost = distmat_km,
  weight = "gaussian") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename("KD2SFCA" = ".")
```
:::


### Computing 3SFCA


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
df_3sfca <- catchment_ratio(
  consumers = hexagons$demand,
  providers = eldercare$capacity,
  cost = distmat_km,
  step_weights,
  normalize_weight = TRUE) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename("3SFCA" = ".")
```
:::
